for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color']=='b' and 20<=n['pixels']<=30:
        b=n['boundary']; rows=[p[0] for p in b]; cols=[p[1] for p in b]
        print("player bbox", (min(rows),min(cols),max(rows),max(cols)))
# red still there?
a=current_frame.ascii; lines=a.split('\n')
reds=sum(1 for r in lines for ch in r if ch=='R')
print("red pixels", reds)
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
